item.title: Self-Hosted Cold Storage Solutions: MinIO ILM vs Ceph Lifecycle vs SeaweedFS Tiered Storage
item.description: When organizations outgrow their primary storage capacity, the cost of keeping all data on high-performance disks becomes unsustainable. Cold storage — storing infrequently accessed data on cheaper media while maintaining on-demand accessibility — solves this problem. Instead of paying AWS Glacier or Azure Archive Storage for long-term retention, you can build a self-hosted cold storage tier using open-source object stores with built-in lifecycle management.
